reviews_captured_by_me.text: Do not hire Cody. I repeat: do not hire Cody. If I could give zero stars, I would. We hired Cody to do our basement floor. We paid the deposit promptly, and then we paid an extra amount he requested "to purchase materials" a month later. Cody then proved to be extremely unaccommodating when it comes to actually doing the job. His availability is this: wait 20-30 days and I will come and do your floor. Never mind the contractor and everyone else. After multiple attempts to correct the situation, we hired someone else for the job, and we are now trying to get our deposit money back. Cody, of course, is claiming that he doesn't owe us anything. To us, it seems he is disorganized, unprofessional, and doesn't understand the value of trust, communication and transparency when dealing with clients. It is a shame. And for the record, this is my first ever negative review. Or positive for that matter. This situation is so unfortunate and unnecessary that I just had to do something.

Truly so happy with the work that Cody did for us. Our spare bathroom was in dire need of some love and renovation. Our vanity top is a custom made top and original to the home. It was looking rough so we were looking to replace it. I’m happened upon Cody’s business and he immediately began sending me ideas and photos and answered all my questions. We scheduled the work and he was on time, professional, quiet, a hard worker and has an amazing personality. I am THRILLED with how my countertops look. What a difference!!!! I will 100% use him again!!
